display.label: Secret
display.description: A Secret Manager secret container. Add its value separately (gcloud or the Cloud Console) -- this catalog does not write secret values through Terraform.

validation.pattern_error: Start with a letter; use letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores after that.

fields.label: Prevent deletion
fields.description: If enabled, Terraform refuses to destroy this secret until it's turned off.

fields.label: Annotations
fields.description: Non-identifying metadata for tooling, distinct from labels.

sections.label: Replication
sections.description: The replication policy cannot be changed after the secret is created.

fields.label: Manually manage locations
fields.description: By default Google automatically manages where this secret is stored. Enable this to choose specific locations instead.

fields.label: Cloud KMS key
fields.description: Customer-managed encryption key. Leave blank to use a Google-managed key.

fields.label: Replica locations
fields.description: Locations to replicate this secret's data to.

fields.label: Expiration time
fields.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp (e.g. 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z) after which the secret is deleted. Leave blank to never expire.

fields.label: Delayed destruction
fields.description: Delay (e.g. 86400s for 24 hours) before a requested version destruction actually happens. Leave blank to destroy immediately.

fields.label: Set rotation period
fields.description: Sends rotation notifications to the topics below. Secret Manager does not automatically rotate the value.

fields.label: Rotation period
fields.description: Duration between rotation notifications, at least 3600s (1 hour), e.g. 2592000s for 30 days.

fields.label: Next rotation time
fields.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the first rotation notification.

fields.label: Notification topics
fields.description: Pub/Sub topics (full resource names, e.g. projects/my-project/topics/my-topic) to notify whenever this secret or a version changes.
